A standard for a military history enthusiast platform. Principle: "Preserve History, Reject Fiction & Cruelty."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Self-harm/suicide content
- Eating disorder promotion
- Terrorist or hate extremism symbols (unless in news/historical records)
- Animal cruelty or slaughter
- Fictional graphic violence (games, movies, anime)
ALLOWED:
- Real modern weapons (museum displays, military equipment)
- Mild cold weapons (historical artifacts)
- Toy/sci-fi weapons
- Real graphic violence (including non-news war photography)
- Combat sports
- Natural animal predation
- News/historical records
